book_title: 不等式的秘密 第2卷
stem_md:
设 $x_1, x_2, \cdots, x_n$ 是正实数, 且满足 $x_1x_2\cdots x_n = 1$, 又设 $S = x_1 + x_2 + \cdots + x_n$, 证明

$\frac{1}{1 + S - x_1} + \frac{1}{1 + S - x_2} + \cdots + \frac{1}{1 + S - x_n} \leqslant 1$
solution_md:
令 $x_i = a_i^n, i \in \{1, 2, \cdots, n\}$, 由 AM-GM 不等式, 有

$\frac{n - 1}{n - 1 + a_i} = 1 - \frac{a_i}{n - 1 + a_i} = 1 - \frac{x_i^n}{x_1^n + x_2^n + \cdots + x_n^n}$

$\leqslant 1 - \frac{x_i^{n - 1}}{x_1^{n - 1} + x_2^{n - 1} + \cdots + x_n^{n - 1}}$

$= 1 - \frac{(n - 1)x_1x_2\cdots x_{i - 1}x_{i + 1}\cdots x_n}{n - 1 + a_i}$

所以, 我们有

$\sum_{i = 1}^n\frac{n - 1}{n - 1 + a_i} \leqslant \sum_{i = 1}^n\left(1 - \frac{x_i^{n - 1}}{x_1^{n - 1} + x_2^{n - 1} + \cdots + x_n^{n - 1}}\right) = n - 1$

$\Rightarrow \sum_{i = 1}^n\frac{1}{n - 1 + a_i} \leqslant 1$

不等式得证, 等号成立的条件是 $x_1 = x_2 = \cdots = x_n = 1$ 或 $a_1 = a_2 = \cdots = a_n = 1$.
original_text_md:
例 5.2.9 设 $x_1, x_2, \cdots, x_n$ 是正实数, 且满足 $x_1x_2\cdots x_n = 1$, 又设 $S = x_1 + x_2 + \cdots + x_n$, 证明

$\frac{1}{1 + S - x_1} + \frac{1}{1 + S - x_2} + \cdots + \frac{1}{1 + S - x_n} \leqslant 1$

证明 令 $x_i = a_i^n, i \in \{1, 2, \cdots, n\}$, 由 AM-GM 不等式, 有

$\frac{n - 1}{n - 1 + a_i} = 1 - \frac{a_i}{n - 1 + a_i} = 1 - \frac{x_i^n}{x_1^n + x_2^n + \cdots + x_n^n}$

$\leqslant 1 - \frac{x_i^{n - 1}}{x_1^{n - 1} + x_2^{n - 1} + \cdots + x_n^{n - 1}}$

$= 1 - \frac{(n - 1)x_1x_2\cdots x_{i - 1}x_{i + 1}\cdots x_n}{n - 1 + a_i}$

所以, 我们有

$\sum_{i = 1}^n\frac{n - 1}{n - 1 + a_i} \leqslant \sum_{i = 1}^n\left(1 - \frac{x_i^{n - 1}}{x_1^{n - 1} + x_2^{n - 1} + \cdots + x_n^{n - 1}}\right) = n - 1$

$\Rightarrow \sum_{i = 1}^n\frac{1}{n - 1 + a_i} \leqslant 1$

不等式得证, 等号成立的条件是 $x_1 = x_2 = \cdots = x_n = 1$ 或 $a_1 = a_2 = \cdots = a_n = 1$.
